en: A sepia-toned photograph of a large stone building with steep gabled roofs, dormer windows, and an ornate corner bay window/turret. The ground floor has a row of arched openings with grilles, above which are several rows of rectangular windows. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along a cobblestone street in front of the building. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image.
